cohort: 789 children from the Cohort for Childhood Origin of Asthma and Allergic Diseases birth cohort study
finding: Prenatal antibiotic exposure and cesarean section delivery were independently associated with childhood asthma, and synergistically increased the risk of asthma, potentially through alterations in early-life gut microbiota composition.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with childhood asthma, especially in combination with prenatal antibiotic exposure.
